summary: Held through a clean run-up to +22.75pts (giveback stayed <=10% the whole way, ER10 climbing steadily 0.26->0.49), then exited the instant the leg round-tripped to -1.00pts with giveback spiking 3%->26% and ER10 punching to 0.60 alongside PROPP firing against - treated the sudden efficiency spike on an adverse move as a real trend-reversal signature, not noise. Next time I'd want to see whether giveback>25% combined with ER10>0.55 is a recurring exit trigger across episodes, and whether waiting one more frame to confirm continuation (vs. reacting on the first big giveback print) costs more than it saves.
